lines.text: Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth—
many a time they have persecuted me from my youth,
but they have not prevailed against me.
The plowmen plowed over my back;
He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
May they be like grass on the rooftops,
which withers before it can grow,
unable to fill the hands of the reaper,
or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
May none who pass by say to them,
“The blessing of the LORD be on you;
we bless you in the name of the LORD.”

pictures.scene: Karel Dujardin, Italiaans landschap met geitenmelkster - the herdsman in his blue jerkin and red cap holding up the bowl of milk while the girl kneels to milk the white goat on the stony track, with the fortified building standing on the rocky height behind them under a bright sky, a song of ascents
pictures.name: pd_dujardin_opgang

pictures.scene: Raphael, Saint Catherine of Alexandria - the saint in her blue grey gown and crimson mantle leaning on the broken spiked wheel with her hand on her breast and her face lifted into the light, many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, let Israel now declare, many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me
pictures.name: pd_raphael_vervolgd

pictures.scene: Winslow Homer, The Veteran in a New Field - the man seen from behind in his white shirt and braces swinging the scythe with the cut swathes lying in long lines at his feet and the standing wheat golden all around him, the plowmen plowed over my back, they made their furrows long, the LORD is righteous, He has cut me from the cords of the wicked
pictures.name: pd_homer_voren

pictures.scene: George Hendrik Breitner, Duinlandschap bij Dekkersduin - the bare dune with its thin olive grass and the dead stump standing black in the middle of it, the blue hills far off and the wide pale sky above, may all who hate Zion be turned back in shame, may they be like grass on the rooftops which withers before it can grow, unable to fill the hands of the reaper or the arms of the binder of sheaves
pictures.name: pd_breitner_verdord

pictures.scene: Rembrandt, Jacob Blessing the Sons of Joseph - the old man laying his hand on the fair head of the boy while Joseph in his white turban guides it and the younger boy looks up from the red coverlet, may none who pass by say to them, the blessing of the LORD be on you, we bless you in the name of the LORD
pictures.name: pd_rembrandt_zegen
